people.name: Tochinoshin Tsuyoshi
people.extract: Tochinoshin Tsuyoshi  is a former professional sumo wrestler from Mtskheta, Georgia. He made his professional debut in March 2006 and was a member of the Kasugano stable. He reached the top makuuchi division just two years later in May 2008.
highlights: Former professional sumo wrestler from Georgia.
Reached top makuuchi division in May 2008.

people.name: John Regis (athlete)
people.extract: John Paul Lyndon Regis, MBE is a British former sprinter. During his career, he won gold medals in the 200 metres at the 1989 World Indoor Championships and the 1990 European Championships, and a silver medal in the distance at the 1993 World Championships.
highlights: Won 200m gold at 1989 World Indoor Championships.
